📖 How to use

      
  1. Drag the seed slider to shuffle through blob shapes.
  2. Adjust complexity (points) and roundness.
  3. Pick a fill color or keep the gradient.
  4. Click "Copy SVG" to grab the ready-to-use code.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Can I recreate the same blob later?
Every seed produces a different-but-deterministic blob, so re-entering the same seed and settings recreates the exact same shape.
Are the blobs scalable?
Blobs are vector SVG paths — infinitely scalable and sharp at any size.
What are blobs used for?
Blob backgrounds, avatars, hero section art, masks for images — anything that needs an organic decorative shape.
